summary: This Form 8-K (Items 4.01, 5.02, 5.03, 8.01) reports the dismissal of Groovy Company's independent auditor, Olayinka Oyebola & Co., following an SEC suspension order related to a securities law consent judgment, and the engagement of a new auditor. The filing also covers director/officer changes, bylaw amendments, and other events. No transaction, merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review is discussed. The registrant is filing routine disclosure of auditor and governance updates, with no special-situation corporate event.
